checks.evidence: mapInjective maps the enumeration with f and constructs its Nodup proof from hf. It represents the actual image, and mem_mapInjective exposes the source witness and equality to the output.
JL040 permits distinct arbitrary source/target universes and all A/B, with universal image elements y and source elements x. Basic image/cardinality facts do not require DecidableEq.
The main theorem requires only global injectivity hf. DecidableEq α/β appears only on the separate intersection helper that computes intersections, matching the specification’s distinction.
The contract fully expands Subset to implications and proves both directions of image inclusion iff original inclusion. The accompanying length contract checks cardinality preservation.

For inclusion reflection, a source x maps into image B; the obtained witness y satisfies f y=f x and is identified with x using hf. Preservation maps the original membership witness forward. No inverse is selected.
